unitFiles.airspace-rf.service:
[Unit]
Description=Airspace RF, FIR and OpenWiFi monitor initialization
After=local-fs.target systemd-modules-load.service
PartOf=airspace.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
Environment=OPENWIFI_RX_GAIN_MODE=manual
Environment=OPENWIFI_RX_GAIN_DB=0
Environment=OPENWIFI_INIT_ONLY=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/doa_stage/systemd/runtime.py rf
TimeoutStartSec=90
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
